title: Serve and Funnel | tailscale/tailscale | DeepWiki
snippet: Aug 19, 2026 · The tailscale serve and tailscale funnel commands allow users to expose local services either within their tailnet or to the public internet. This functionality is implemented through a combination of configuration management in LocalBackend, TCP/HTTP request interception, and coordination with Tailscale's ingress infrastructure.
